description: Recorded live on codex-cli 0.170.0 (`codex exec --json`, read-only sandbox): a shell tool command in a root thread sees CODEX_SESSION_ID and CODEX_THREAD_ID, and both equal the thread id from `thread.started`. `ovld protocol attach` run by a Codex agent therefore indexes CODEX_SESSION_ID in the native-session index under the `codex` agent: the same id Codex hooks send as `session_id` (the root session, also inside subagents) and the id the status line provider reads as `thread.id` for a root thread.
